verdict.rationale: ClickUp explicitly advertises a 'Triage Agent' that prioritizes bugs, plus general automation and custom-agent building tools, directly matching the story. However, evidence is a single thin vendor tagline with no detail on triage logic, configuration, or independent/hands-on validation that it works as claimed. missing for 10: detailed documentation of triage criteria/workflow, independent or hands-on confirmation of the Triage Agent's effectiveness.
